scripts.dev: bun run build && DISPUTESHIELD_DEMO_MODE=1 uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.test: bun run llm:start && bun run build && uv run pytest -q
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p . --noEmit && uv run mypy app tests
scripts.demo:frames: ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration:stream=codec_name,width,height -of compact out/disputeshield-demo.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -i out/disputeshield-demo.mp4 -vf fps=1/10,scale=960:-2 out/frame-%02d.png
